description: ROLE PURPOSE The Performance & Growth Manager is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of paid media, data analytics, and commercial strategy. You are responsible for building and optimising the growth engine that drives patient acquisition owning the full patient journey from first digital impression through to booked appointment, attended consultation, and long-term retention. Working closely with senior leadership, you will manage a high-performing team, take direct ownership of performance marketing channels, and ensure every marketing investment is tied to measurable patient outcomes. You bring both the strategic perspective to plan quarterly growth roadmaps and the technical depth to optimise campaigns at the ad-set level. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Growth Strategy & Team Leadership Growth Planning: Translate commercial objectives into a quarterly growth roadmap with clear priorities across paid, organic, and partnership channels. Partner with the content and social media teams to execute high-impact campaigns, rapidly iterating on underperforming initiatives to build a resilient, forward-looking performance marketing plan. Team Management: Directly manage and develop a team of growth marketers setting performance standards, coaching individuals, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Proactive Optimisation: Monitor market trends, platform changes, and competitor activity to anticipate shifts and adapt strategy accordingly, you don't wait to be told. Reporting & Stakeholder Communication: Deliver regular, high-quality performance reports to senior leadership. Translate campaign data into clear commercial narratives focused on CAC, LTV, and revenue contribution. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Content, Medical, Product/Tech, and Finance teams to ensure clinical accuracy in messaging, optimise the digital patient journey, and manage budget efficiency. Omnichannel Performance Marketing Full-Funnel Ownership: Develop and execute omnichannel paid and organic strategies across Meta, Google, TikTok, and SEO driving new patient acquisition while building re-engagement programmes that grow retention and lifetime value. Signal & Measurement Mastery: Build and maintain a robust tracking and measurement framework across all paid channels, ensuring data integrity and accurate attribution across the full funnel. Creative Testing & Iteration: Build and run a structured A/B testing programme across creative, copy, audiences, and landing pages iterating continuously based on performance data and using findings to sharpen every channel. Budget & Efficiency: Own the performance marketing budget with a relentless focus on CAC, LTV, and ROAS ensuring every dirham is fully accountable. Lead Quality & Qualification: Develop and maintain a structured lead qualification framework to prioritise high-value patient leads and improve overall funnel efficiency. Lead Quality, Funnel Optimisation & Conversion Funnel Accountability: Own the Lead → Booked Appointment conversion rate, ensuring marketing-generated demand is efficiently converted into attended clinical appointments. CRM & Lead Nurture: Design and oversee structured lead nurture workflows across SMS, WhatsApp, and email to maximise engagement and reduce funnel drop-off. Speed to Lead: Maintain a sub-5-minute response target for all new inbound leads, capturing intent at its peak. Conversion Benchmarks: Drive and sustain a Lead-to-Booking conversion rate of 25–40%, depending on channel and treatment type. No-Show Reduction: Manage a structured confirmation and re-engagement process to achieve appointment show-rates above 85%. Data Quality: Maintain clean, structured CRM records to enable accurate attribution and reliable performance reporting. Content, Medical Collaboration & Compliance Content Strategy: Partner with the medical and content teams to build a pipeline of clinically accurate, conversion-focused creative assets Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all campaigns and creative adhere to UAE healthcare advertising standards and platform policies at all times. Doctor-Led Content: Champion the use of physician-authored content and video as core performance assets, managing production timelines and publishing cadence. Patient Education: Commission and manage a patient education content programme condition guides, treatment explainers, and post-consultation resources that builds trust, supports clinical engagement, and improves retention. Thought Leadership: Own the brand's authority positioning in the metabolic health space, commissioning clinical commentary and thought leadership that establishes Metabolic as the leading voice in the category. Brand Consistency & Global Market Intelligence: Ensure all paid and organic assets strictly align with brand tone, visual standards, and clinical positioning. Concurrently, conduct continuous competitive analysis of industry-specific marketing campaigns both within the UAE and globally. Leverage these insights to inform a data-driven content ideation strategy, identifying high-performing trends and adapting successful international methodologies to maximize local campaign ROI. THE GROWTH TECH STACK The candidate must be a proficient architect or power user of: Ad Platforms: Meta Business Suite (CAPI), Google Ads (PMax), TikTok Ads Manager. Analytics: GA4, CRM (Salesforce / HubSpot), and Data Visualisation (Tableau / Mixpanel). CRM, Communications & Automation: WhatsApp Business, SMS platforms, and CRM tools for automated lead management, conversational AI/chatbots, and hyper-personalized follow-up workflows. Emerging Tech & AI Efficiency: Proficient in using third-party AI software (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Jasper, or specialized ad-creative/copywriting AI tools) to streamline content creation, conduct rapid market research, and optimize campaign variations at scale. WHY THIS ROLE? This is not a routine marketing position. You will have real budget, a talented team, and the creative freedom to build a world-class patient acquisition engine in one of the world's most competitive healthcare markets with direct visibility of the impact your work has on patient outcomes. You will work alongside experienced senior leadership, have ownership of meaningful commercial levers, and be genuinely empowered to shape how the company grows. Requirements 5-8 years in Growth or Performance Marketing, with at least 2 years in a team management role. Demonstrated track record driving patient or consumer acquisition in Healthcare, Clinics, or HealthTech ideally within the UAE/GCC. Hands-on experience managing significant paid media budgets with direct accountability for performance outcomes. Experience designing or managing lead nurture programmes and conversion workflows across multiple channels. The “Growth” DNA Revenue-Focused: You care about qualified leads, conversion rates, and cost-per-acquisition not impressions or reach. Proactive & Self-Directed: You identify gaps before they become problems, and you move quickly to address them. Analytical & Creative: You can interrogate granular campaign data and also judge what makes a creative stop the scroll. Clear Communicator: You move comfortably between a technical briefing with developers and a commercial update to leadership. You Are… A Hands-On Leader: You manage and develop your team while remaining deeply involved in day-to-day execution. Commercially Grounded: You think in unit economics and growth efficiency, not vanity metrics. Adaptable: You thrive in fast-paced, high-expectation environments where priorities shift and pace is relentless. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS KPI What It Measures Blended CAC vs. LTV Efficiency and profitability of patient acquisition across all channels. Lead-to-Booking Conversion Rate Effectiveness of the full acquisition funnel from lead to confirmed appointment. ROAS by Channel Return on ad spend per platform, tracked and optimised monthly. Partner-Generated Leads & Revenue Commercial impact of the Business Development & Partnerships function. Appointment Show Rate Downstream indicator of lead quality and nurture workflow effectiveness. Patient Retention & Referral Growth Rate of patient re-engagement and volume of new patients acquired through referral programmes. Team Development Individual growth, performance, and retention of direct reports.
title: Performance & Growth Manager

description: Company Description Square Yards is a full-stack proptech platform that supports the entire consumer journey in real estate, from search and discovery through transactions, mortgages, home furnishing, rentals, and property management. The organization is also building disruptive B2B platforms for developers, financial institutions, and agents, creating integrated solutions across the value chain. With over 15,000 transactions worth more than USD 1 billion annually, Square Yards operates with profitable economics and a strong growth trajectory. The company has successfully expanded globally, with a significant share of revenue from markets such as the Middle East, Australia, and Canada. Leveraging data analytics and VR tools, as well as adjacent B2C platforms like Azuro, Interior Company, and Square Capital, Square Yards aims to transform the traditional real estate marketplace and build India’s first MLS. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Growth Manager role based in Bengaluru, focused on driving B2C growth in the real estate segment. The Growth Manager will oversee and execute customer acquisition, activation, and retention strategies, collaborating closely with sales, marketing, product, and operations teams. Day-to-day responsibilities include analyzing growth metrics, identifying high-impact opportunities, optimizing conversion funnels, and leading initiatives to improve customer experience and lifetime value. The role involves designing and running experiments, managing cross-functional growth projects, and building scalable processes for lead generation and nurturing. The Growth Manager will also monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer insights to refine growth plans and support overall business targets. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and experience with Analytics tools to interpret data, track KPIs, and derive actionable insights. Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, including stakeholder management, presentation abilities, and clear written and verbal communication. Candidates should possess solid Sales skills, with experience in B2C growth, lead management, and conversion optimization in real estate or related industries. Candidates should possess Project Management capabilities to plan, prioritize, and execute cross-functional growth initiatives within defined timelines. 4–8 years of relevant experience in growth, sales, or business management, preferably in proptech, real estate, or consumer internet businesses. Experience with CRM systems, marketing automation, and performance marketing will be beneficial. Ability to work with cross-functional teams, handle ambiguity, and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Economics, or a related field is preferred.
title: Growth Manager (Real Estate Sales B2C) (4 - 6yrs exp only)
